Oh? Could it be that you, Erlang Shen,
are secretly a fan of treasure hunts?
m920179.おや、冥界の亜神は言霊の力をご存知でない？: Oh? Does the Demigod of the Underworld not know the power of words?
m920179.きっとこのゴースト……サメは、\n王子のことを好敵手と認めたんですよ。: It seems this ghost…… shark has acknowledged the Prince as a worthy rival.
m920179.きゃっほー！ 覚悟しろ王子ー！！\n真夏に輝く一番星にしてあげるからねー！:
Kyah-ho! Brace yourself, Prince!!
I'm going to make you the brightest star of midsummer!
m920179.くぅぅぅぅッ！\nいいねぇ、海戦ってのはこうじゃないとなァ！！:
Kuuuuh!
This is what a sea battle is supposed to be about!!
m920179.こ、これは……！\n王子の！ 水着姿……！？:
W-What is this…!
The Prince's… swimsuit…!?
m920179.こいつ、生気が感じられないな……。\nいや、ゾンビの時点でそうなんだが、\nそれ:
I can't sense any life force here……
Well, that's to be expected for a zombie, but
even beyond that, there's something else.
m920179.ここを荒らしに来たわけじゃないって、\n分かってくれたのでしょうか……？: I wonder if it understood that we didn't come here to cause trouble……?
m920179.この島の環境に悪影響を及ぼすわ……。\nただでさえ、外界の影響を受けず、\nずっ:
It'll damage the island's environment...
This place has always maintained its own unique ecosystem, completely isolated from the outside world.
m920179.この海域は、静かで穏やか、\n船乗りからも安心して航行できる場所だって言われてる:
This area is usually calm and peaceful,
known as a safe place for sailors to navigate.
m920179.この魚人の群れに、引きずり込まれるような海流。\nまさか伝説をこの目にしちゃうな:
This swarm of merfolk, and a current that seems to be pulling us in.
To actually witness a legend with my own eyes……!
m920179.これは……まさか、去年の激戦を覚えて……？\nそうか、そういうことだったのですね: This is…… could it be remembering the fierce battle from last year? I see, that must be it.
m920179.さぁ……？\nそれより、この島の探索が先じゃない？:
Who knows……?
Besides, shouldn't we prioritize exploring this island?
m920179.さぁお嬢さん、見ていておくれ……。\nこれが俺たち海賊のルール……勝ったもん勝ち:
Now then, miss, watch closely……
This is our pirate rule…… the winner takes all……
m920179.せーの……森へおかえり……。: On the count of three… back to the forest…
m920179.そういうわけだ、\nこの島の恐竜は、根こそぎオレたちがいただくぜェ！！:
That's why,
we're taking every dinosaur on this island for ourselves!!
m920179.そうしょく……ということは\nおとなしい子なんですね！\nわーい、なでなでしに―:
Herbivore…… so that means
it's a gentle one, right!
Yay, I'm going to pet it—
m920179.そうだぜ！ 海にロマン感じた大馬鹿がもう一人ィ！\nあの海賊旗はデューオんとこだ:
That's right! Another massive fool who found romance in the sea!
That pirate flag… that's Duo's crew, isn't it!
m920179.そうですよ！\n恐竜さんたち、この島で平和に暮らしてるんですから！:
That's right!
The dinosaurs are living peacefully on this island!
m920179.そうね、自分の迷惑を正当化するようでは、\n冥界に来る頃にはどす黒い魂に染まって:
I agree. If you try to justify your own troublemaking,
I think your soul will be pitch black by the time you reach the underworld.
m920179.そこで一緒に海遊びとは……。\nその商人たちに騙されているような気もしますが、\:
So, we're going to have a beach outing together…
It feels like we're being tricked by those merchants,
but I suppose there's some merit to the idea.
m920179.そこで商人の方々に相談してみたところ、\n海上演習後の合同懇親会に、\nこの水着:
So, we consulted with some merchants, and they suggested
that if we wear these swimsuits to the joint reception
after the naval exercises, everything would be solved!
m920179.そしてそこの、オレの見事なダイヴ＆スイムを\nじっくり見つめてくれた獣人のお嬢さ:
And you there, the beastkin girl who watched
my magnificent dive and swim with such interest…
m920179.そしてその好敵手が、\n島を荒らしに来た海賊と\n戦ってくれたことを理解した……: And it understood that its worthy rival fought the pirates who came to ravage the island……?
m920179.そのとおりだぜ、アイリーン……。\nだが！ 漢に生まれた以上！\nロマンと冒険か:
That's right, Irene……
But! Since I was born a man!
I can't run from romance and adventure!!
m920179.そのままお返ししますよ、亜神殿。\nというか、私にやけにつっかかりますね？:
I'll just return that to you, Sub-temple.
Besides, why are you being so snippy with me?
m920179.それ、最高ね！！\nよぉし、次の戦闘は、このメンバーで\n王子を着替えさせに掛か:
That's perfect!!
Alright, for the next battle, let's have this team
take the Prince to change clothes♪
m920179.それに潮の動き方もおかしい。\nこれはもしかすると……。:
And the tides are moving strangely, too.
Could this be……?
m920179.そんなことさせないって言ってるんだってば！\nあーもう、もう一度斧でぶん殴って―: I'm telling you I won't let that happen! Ugh, hit him again with the axe—wait, what?
m920179.た、大変ですー！\nあるじ様、前方から魚人の群れがー！:
H-Help!
Master, there's a swarm of merfolk coming from ahead!
m920179.だからこそ、こうして総員で、\n根こそぎ昆虫を捕獲しているんだねぇ。:
That's why we're all here,
collecting every last insect we can find.
m920179.だが漢はへこたれない！\n諦めない！ 反省しないのさ！:
But a man doesn't give in!
He doesn't give up! And he doesn't reflect!
m920179.ちっちっち、お嬢さん。\n漢はちょっと迷惑なくらいがカッコイイのさ……。:
Tsk, tsk, tsk, miss.
A man looks cool when he causes a little trouble, you know……
m920179.ちょっと妙道！ 見えない！\nアタシにも見せてー！:
Hey, Miaodao! I can't see!
Show me, too!
m920179.ちょっと空模様が怪しくなっててね。\nこの辺りは穏やかな海域なんだけど、\nちょ:
The weather's looking a bit shady.
This is usually a calm sea area,
but it might get rough, so I'm here to report in.
m920179.つまり、ゴーストダブルヘッドメカゾンビシャーク。: So, a Ghost Double-Headed Mech Zombie Shark.
m920179.つまり可能なら近付かず、\n遠距離から仕留めた方が良さそうということですね。\n:
In other words, it's best to keep your distance
and take it down from afar if possible.
Prince, please give orders to your long-range specialists!
m920179.で、でんせつ……？\nいったいどういうことなんです……？:
A-A legend……?
What does that mean……?
m920179.できるだけ魔法で攻撃して、\nぶっ飛ばした方がいいということね。: It means we should use magic to blast it away.
m920179.でもね、渦巻く雲が現れた時にだけ、\n海流が変化して、\nある島へ続く海路が開か:
But when those swirling clouds appear, the currents shift,
and a sea route opens up
leading to a certain island.
m920179.ともかく、その水着を装備するときには、\n称号を【真夏の主役】に変更してください:
Anyway, when you equip that swimsuit,
please change your title to 【Star of the Midsummer】!
m920179.ともかく、虫さんたちは逃してあげよう。\nさぁお前たちも虫かごを開くんだ。:
In any case, I'll let the bugs go.
Now, you all open your cages.
m920179.どうしてアタシの方見るのー！？\nうぅぅ、全然話が通じないよぉ！:
Why are you looking at me!?
Ugh, I can't get through to you at all!
m920179.どうにもならないじゃーん！？\n王子、こうなったら反省したくなるくらい、\n全力: This is hopeless! Prince, if it comes to this, give him a punishment so severe he'll want to repent!
m920179.な、なっ、なななっ、\nなんだそのパワー！？\nうおおぉぉぉッ、お、覚えてろぉぉ:
W-what, what, what...
What kind of power is that!?
Ugh... you'll pay for this...
m920179.なっ……だめだよ！\n自分のロマンのために迷惑かけるとか最低じゃない！？:
Wha…… no way!
Causing trouble for your own romance is the worst, don't you think!?
m920179.なでなでストップ！ ハツネ戻りますぅぅぅ！！: Petting is off! I'm coming back, Hatsune!!
m920179.なにあいつー！！\nなんで雨の中で高笑いしてるのさー！:
Who is that guy!
Why is he cackling in the rain!
m920179.なんだ、みんな興味ありってこと？\nよぉーし、じゃあこのまま風に身を任せて、\n:
So everyone's interested, huh?
Alright then, let's just go with the wind
and set sail for that legendary island!!
m920179.なんだか半透明ですけど、\nダブルヘッドメカゾンビシャークさんですよね？\nもし:
It looks a bit translucent, but...
Is that the Double-Headed Mech Zombie Shark?
Could it be... here to help us?
m920179.は、はぁ……。\nところでこの社員旅行、何が目的で……？:
Y-Yeah…
By the way, what's the purpose of this company trip…?
m920179.はぁ……あいつのことだから、\n嘘や虚勢じゃなくて、間違いなく本気で言ってるわね:
Hah… Given who he is,
I'm sure he's not lying or bluffing; he's dead serious.
Honestly, that's taking it a bit too far.
m920179.はぁ……秘境を知り尽くした大海賊だって聞いてたのに、\nあんな変な奴だったなんて:
Haa… I heard he was a legendary pirate who knew every hidden corner of the seas,
but I'm so disappointed he's such a weirdo…
m920179.はい、そこまでー！\n空が荒れてるのに船の上まで荒れない！:
Y-yes, that's enough!
The sky is roughing up, but don't let the ship rough up too!
m920179.はい、亜神ディアスいわく、\n戦いたいのなら、相応しい実力を身に着けた上で、\n:
Yes. The Demigod Zeus said that if we want to fight,
we should come to meet him at Olympus
only after acquiring the strength to match him.
m920179.ひょぉー！！\n懐かしいぜその視線！ 闇ギルドを思い出すッ！:
Hoo-hoo!!
That look! It brings back memories of the Dark Guild!
m920179.ふふ、あなたの気にし過ぎじゃないかしら？\n今後のためにも、\n今から善行は積ん:
Hehe, aren't you just being overly sensitive?
For your own sake,
you should probably start doing some good deeds now.
m920179.ふふ、皆似たもの同士だということですね。\nしかし、スリーの行方が分からない状況:
Heh, it seems we are all of a like mind.
However, with Three's whereabouts still unknown,
we can't afford to linger here for long.
m920179.ふふっ、話し合いの余地も、更生の余地もないから、\n逮捕されて以来ずーっと檻に入:
Hehe, since there was no room for negotiation or rehabilitation,
he's been locked in a cage ever since his arrest.
m920179.ふふふ、夏は始まったばかりなのに、\nそんな油断していていいのかなぁ？:
Heh, summer has barely even begun, and yet
is it wise to be so complacent?
m920179.ふむ……君たちはこの森の地主なのかね？: Hm… Are you the landowners of this forest?
m920179.ふむぅ……。\nワシも色々と模索中でね。:
Hmm…
I'm still trying to figure a lot of things out, myself.
m920179.へぇぇ……ナイス腹筋、デリシャス大胸筋……。\nとか言ってる場合じゃなくて！:
Heee… Nice abs, delicious pecs…
Now's not the time for that!
m920179.ま、今は休息と訓練を続けるしかないってことだね！\n――それで、そこの亜神さんは:
Well, I guess we have no choice but to rest and train for now!
—Speaking of which, what's wrong with the Lesser God over there?
She looks a million miles away.
m920179.まぁそれも事実だけど、それ以上に変なヤツなのさ。\nでも愉快なのは見た目と言動だ:
Well, that's true, but he's weirder than that.
The fun part is just how he looks and acts!
His favorite gun is a shotgun with a nasty surprise!
m920179.まさか、ダブルヘッドメカゾンビシャーク……！？\n生きていたというのか！？:
Could it be... the Double-Headed Mech Zombie Shark...?
It's still alive?
m920179.まったく、パトリシアったら。\nほら、体幹をしっかり！ これも鍛錬ですよ！:
Honestly, Patricia.
Come on, keep your core steady! This is part of the training!
m920179.まったくだ。\nこれは亜神たちとの戦いを想定した、\n二国合同の海上戦闘演習なの:
Exactly.
This is a joint naval combat exercise
designed with battles against the Demigods in mind.
m920179.まったくです。\n乙女の柔肌を見ておきながら、\n自分はその肉体美をさらしたくな:
Truly.
While gazing at a maiden's soft skin,
he himself doesn't want to expose his own physique?
m920179.みんな、何かに捕まって！\nこのまま幻の島まで一気に抜けるよ！！:
Everyone, hold on to something!
We're going to blast through to the phantom island in one go!!
m920179.みんなに船酔いに気をつけるように言っておいて？\nアタシは船員に指示を出してくる:
Please remind everyone to watch out for seasickness?
I'll go give the crew some instructions!
m920179.むぅ、この雨で遠間が狙いにくいっていうのに……。: Mmm, the rain makes long-range shots so hard to land…….
m920179.むぅぅ、王子のガード固すぎー！！: Muuu, the Prince's guard is way too solid!!
m920179.もしかすると……？\nな、なに？ 何か怖いことでも起きるの！？:
Could this be……?
W-What is it? Is something scary going to happen!?
m920179.もちろん、夏をめいっぱい楽しむ覚悟、だよ♪: Of course, to enjoy the summer to the fullest! ♪
m920179.よ、よし、ショックを受けてる今のうちだ！\n面舵いっぱーい！ 距離を取れ！！:
A-Alright, while you're still in shock!
Full speed ahead! Keep your distance!!
m920179.よぉし、それじゃあ模擬戦も終わったことだし！\nこのままビーチに戻って――:
Alright, since the mock battle is over!
Let's head back to the beach and—
m920179.わぁっ、角が３本も生えた恐竜さんですよ！: Whoa, a dinosaur with three horns!
m920179.わかんないよぉ？\n偶然にその島にたどり着いた海賊が、\nお宝を隠してるかもしれ:
Who knows?
Maybe pirates who stumbled upon the island by accident
hid treasure there!
m920179.わっ、噂のレーヴちゃん日誌だ！\nすごいすごい！ もうスケッチもしてある！:
Whoa, it's the famous Reve's journal!
Amazing, amazing! She's even done a sketch!
m920179.ん……どうしたのデューオさん。\nそんな深刻そうな顔をして。:
Hm? What's wrong, Duo?
You've got such a serious look on your face.
m920179.んっ、難しいも何も、\nパトリシアには私がいるでしょうがー！\nこのっ、このこの:
Hm, complex my foot!
I'm right here for you, Patricia!
This, this, this—!
m920179.イーリス、これはそんな雰囲気じゃない。\nさっきのドラコトプスと同じだ、\n縄張: Iris, that's not the vibe. It's just like that dracotops earlier—someone's territory got invaded and they're angry!
m920179.エサヌキヤダー！: I don't want my rations cut!
m920179.オカシラ！ バカ！\nアメフリ！ ツバサビショビショ！:
Captain! Idiot!
It's raining! You're getting all wet and shivering!
m920179.オカシラ！ フラレタ！ オカシラフラレター！！: Head! You got rejected! The head got rejected!
m920179.オーマイハニー。\nお嬢さんのためなら嵐の海も、\n渦潮も落雷も何のその、遅れば:
Oh my honey!
For a young lady like you, a stormy sea, a whirlpool, or a lightning strike are nothing!
We've arrived, just a little late!!
m920179.グルメジャングルでも遭遇したけど、\nやっぱり恐竜って強いしカッコイイよねぇ。:
We encountered some in the Gourmet Jungle too,
but dinosaurs are just strong and cool, aren't they?
m920179.ケッ、サメは海賊のお友達！\nメカだろうが飛んでようが、恐くなんか――グッハァ！:
Tch, sharks are a pirate's best friends!
Mech or not, flying or not, I'm not afraid of— Guhah!?
m920179.ゴースト化したとなれば、\n物理的な攻撃も効きにくくなっているはずよ。: If it has turned into a ghost, physical attacks should be less effective against it.
m920179.サムイ！ ツメタイ！\nオカシラオバカ！:
Cold! Freezing!
You're a big, stupid idiot!
m920179.サメにすら認められるとは、\nさすがは王子殿というべきなのでしょうか……。:
To be recognized even by a shark...
I suppose that is truly worthy of Your Highness.
m920179.スリー……闇の組織のスリーか！？\nあいつ、檻にぶち込まれてただろぉ！？:
Three… Three from the Shadow Organization?
Wasn't he locked up in a cage?
m920179.スリーは根っからの海賊気質。\nロマンと冒険と、富と名声が大好物で、\nそのため:
Three is a pirate through and through.
He's obsessed with romance, adventure, wealth, and fame,
and he'll use any means necessary to get them.
m920179.ダブルヘッド……じゃなかった、\nゴーストダブルヘッドメカゾンビシャークさんは、: The Double-Headed…… no, the Ghost Double-Headed Mech Zombie Shark also had a barrier that nullified certain attacks……
m920179.デーモンシェフとワシの差はなんだったのか、\nどうすれば、この物質界でなり上がれ:
What was the difference between the Demon Chef and me?
How can I make my way in this material world…?
m920179.ニゲラレナイ！ ニガサナイ！: We can't run! We won't run!
m920179.バカダカラ！ オカシラオオバカ！: Because he's an idiot! A big, stupid idiot!
m920179.パトリシア、こっちに！\n私に捕まっていてください！:
Patricia, over here!
Hold on to me!
m920179.ヤーハーッッッ！！\n檻なんかじゃオレは止められねェんだよぉ！！:
Yah-ha-ha!
A cage is no match for me!
m920179.ヤーハーッ！\n久しいなぁデューオ！:
Yah-ha!
Long time no see, Duo!
m920179.レオーネ、良いことを教えてあげましょう。\n悪いことを口に出すと、本当になるので:
Leone, let me tell you something good.
If you speak of bad things, they come true.
m920179.レオーネ！ あいつの姿を見失わないで！\n嵐の海に飛び込んで、こっちの懐まで泳ぐ:
Leone! Don't lose sight of him!
Diving into the storm and swimming straight into our range
is Three's standard tactic!!
m920179.ワシも先達への敬意は忘れていない。\nそれに、生態系、だったかな？\nそれが大切:
I haven't forgotten my respect for my predecessors.
And I understand now that the ecosystem,
or whatever it's called, is something precious.
m920179.ンンッ、そんなちいせぇコト気にしてんのか？\nどうせ恐竜たちは、まとめて\nオレ:
Hmph, you worry about such trivial things?
I'm just going to sell all the dinosaurs in one lot, so it doesn't matter anyway!
m920179.一応、各地の港には警戒するよう伝えたが、\n容易には足取りを追えないだろうな。:
I've sent word to the ports in the region to stay on high alert,
but it won't be easy to track his movements.
m920179.中でも超高額、幻のカブトムシを捕まえた者には、\n特別ボーナスを支給しちゃうから:
For anyone who catches the priceless phantom rhinoceros beetle,
I'll be paying a special bonus.
m920179.主食は草だけれど、縄張り意識が極めて強く、\n侵入者には容赦ない突撃をするし、\:
It primarily eats plants, but it has an extremely strong territorial instinct.
It charges at intruders without mercy,
and once it starts running, it won't stop.
m920179.二度と会いたくなかったけどね！！\nそのまま檻に入ってればよかったんだよ！:
I never wanted to see you again!
You should have just stayed in that cage!
m920179.伝説の！ 島！\nつまり……お宝ってことだね！！:
A legendary island!
So that means……treasure, right?!
m920179.冥界の亜神殿も、きっと驚くことでしょう。\n今から覚悟を決めておくべきですね。:
The Underworld's Lesser God Temple will surely be astonished.
We should prepare ourselves for that now.
m920179.勘違いされたままじゃ無事に帰れないし！\n王子、ここは戦うしかなさそうだよ！: But if I'm misunderstood like this, I won't be able to go home safely! Prince, it looks like we have no choice but to fight!
m920179.友よ、せっかくだから\n海水浴でもして遊んでいけ、ってところかしらね。: "Friend, since you're here, feel free to enjoy a swim," I suppose.
m920179.地主じゃないなら、黙っていてもらおうねぇ。\nそれでも止めるというのなら、\n少:
If you're not the landowners, I'll have to ask you to stay quiet.
If you insist on stopping us,
I suppose I'll have to deal with you a little.
m920179.地図にも載っていない幻の島ですからね！\nぜひとも記録を残しておこうと思いまして:
It's a phantom island that isn't on any map!
I wanted to make sure to leave a record of it.
m920179.夏の遊びと言えば、海水浴と昆虫採集。\nそして昆虫と言えば、高く売れるらしいんだ:
When it comes to summer fun, it's swimming and insect collecting.
And insects, it seems, fetch a high price.
m920179.太公望みたいなことを言いますね……！！\n私はよかれと思ってお説教をしているんで:
Don't speak to me like Taigong Wang…!!

m920203.こいつはそれ以前、原初の東の国の存在。\n武士道とかそういうのじゃなく、どっちか:
This guy predates all that. He's a primordial entity from the East.
It's not a matter of bushido or anything like that.
If anything, he's closer to a force of nature.
Or a concept, like us yokai.
m920203.こいつも、知性派きっての武闘派とか嘘にゃ。\n武闘派中の武闘派にゃ。:
Calling someone like that a "scholarly brawler" is a complete lie.
She's a brawler through and through.
m920203.この世界のため、だよ。\n天墜神星さまは、神の横暴に人が害されぬよう、\n人と神:
It's for the sake of this world.
Amatsu-Mikaboshi-sama wished to separate the worlds of humans and gods
so that people would not be harmed by the gods' tyranny.
m920203.この者がそれを望むことは、ないでしょう。\n天墜神星さまも、王子の人徳は認めてい:
I don't think he would.
Amatsumikaboshi herself acknowledged the Prince's virtue.
m920203.この詠唱……あぁもうっ、星が乱れすぎです……。\n全然星が読み解けませんよ……！:
This incantation… oh no, the stars are too chaotic…
I can't read them at all…!
m920203.これしきの流星で死ぬ戦士ではあるまい？\nだが、施した呪力は、\nその身の力を大:
Surely you are not a warrior who would be killed by mere meteors?
However, the cursed power I have bestowed
will greatly drain the strength from your bodies.
m920203.これだから、頭まで筋肉でできてるぽやぽや娘は……。: This is exactly why I can't stand that fluffy, muscle-brained girl…
m920203.これは笑わせる。\n殺し合いに卑怯も何もないだろう？:
You're amusing.
There is no such thing as “dishonorable” in a battle to the death.
m920203.ご心配なく。\nあたしたちは加護を受けているから、\n問題なく通過できるはずだよ:
Don't worry.
We're under divine protection,
so we should be able to pass through without any trouble.
m920203.ご明察。\nさすがは名高き夢の亜神、ヒュープ様。\nというわけで、ここ、通してく:
Sharp observation.
As expected of the renowned Sub-deity of Dreams, Hupe.
So, would you mind letting us through?
m920203.さぁ、人の身でどこまで人を外れたのか、\nこの私に見せてみよ、今はまだ、人間の王:
Come now, show me how far you have strayed from being human,
you who are still a human Prince.
m920203.さぁて、何をしかけてくるやら。\n王子、気を抜くんじゃねェぞ！:
Well now, who knows what they'll pull.
Prince, don't you let your guard down!
m920203.さっきまでの比じゃない、ってことですねぇ？\nでもここでなら、アマツミカボシにも:
So it's nothing like before, huh?
But from here, we can reach Amatsu-Mikaboshi with our attacks.
Let's hit it with everything we've got!
m920203.しかし、あれはあくまで鏡像、\n虚空に投影された写し身にすぎぬ。\n転移の力たる:
However, that is merely a mirror image,
a projection cast into the void, nothing more.
It appears to lack the "Divine Radiance" of transposition.
m920203.しかし、そこに人の子の運命を巻き込むのは、\nどうにも承服しかねるものでな。\n:
However, I cannot accept dragging a human's fate into this.
I am afraid I must interfere with your plans.
m920203.しばし、眠る。\nお前たちはそのまま、王子に助力せよ。:
I shall sleep for a while.
You, continue to aid the Prince.
m920203.そいつは傲慢だぜ？\n人間に、人間らしくあるなって言うのは。:
That's pretty arrogant, isn't it?
Telling humans they can't be human.
m920203.そいつを最後に出撃させればいい。\nよし、作戦会議終わり！\nさぁ星神狩りと行こ:
Just deploy them last.
Alright, that's the strategy meeting over!
Let's go hunt that Star God!
--- scene: Olympus Fifth Layer (battle, end) ---
m920203.そう……これが、星神……！\n王子君、星が、来ます！ 空から！！:
Yes…… this is the power of the Star God……!
Prince, the stars are coming! From the sky!!
m920203.そうかよ、この堅物邪神が。\nおい王子、さっさとケリをつけ――ん？\nどうしたソ:
I see, you stubborn evil god.
Hey, Prince, let's wrap this up quick――hmm?
What's with you, Solais? You've got a weird look on your face.
m920203.そうだぜチズル。\nサムライの流儀は戦乱の時代に生まれたモンだ。:
That's right, Chizuru.
The samurai code was born in an age of constant war.
m920203.そこの王子は、神の試練をいくつ乗り越えた。\n神の座に至るための試練を、\n知ら:
How many trials of the gods has that Prince there overcome?
How many trials on the path to the divine seat
has he been forced to endure, without even knowing it?
m920203.そしてイヨよ、次代の我が依代よ、\n決戦においては、お前の力を貸してもらおう。:
And Iyo, my vessel for the next generation,
I will borrow your power in the decisive battle.
m920203.そして王子、これからは人を庇護するのではなく、\n人と共に戦う道を選ぶことを約束:
And Prince, swear to me that from now on,
you will choose the path of fighting alongside humanity,
rather than merely shielding them.
m920203.その身に神の力が宿れば、\nあるいは亜神ディアスにすら手が届くのかもしれないな。:
If the power of the gods dwells within you,
perhaps you could even reach for the position of the Lesser God Dias.
m920203.それじゃあ英雄王の子孫くん――うぅん、王子殿下。\nこれからよろしくお願いします:
Well then, descendant of the Hero King—uh, Your Highness.
It's a pleasure to work with you from now on.♪
m920203.それでも、よ。\nだからこそ、王子、あなたはここで、\n人である内に命を終えなけ:
Even so.
That is precisely why, Prince, you must end your life
while you are still human.
m920203.それでも、神獣である以上気は抜けません。\n王子、慎重な指揮をお願いします！:
Even so, we cannot let our guard down while a divine beast is involved.
Prince, please command with the utmost caution!
m920203.それは人の持つ成長の力。\nそして強き願いは、いずれ神すら殺す野心に至るものよ。:
That is the power of human growth.
And a strong desire will eventually turn into an ambition that can even kill a god.
m920203.それは概ね間違いじゃない。\n今の東の国を作ったのは、\n天墜神星さまを討った神:
That's not entirely wrong.
The gods who slew Amatsumikaboshi
are the ones who built the Eastern Kingdom as it stands today.
m920203.そんな高尚なものではない。\nそれに連中の導きに従うのが、正しい自然の摂理だ。\:
It was nothing so noble.
Following their guidance is the true order of nature.
Without growth and struggle, life cannot evolve.
m920203.だいたい、こういうのは武闘派のゼクメトの役割にゃ。\nあたしはもっと知的で優雅な:
Besides, this is Zekmet's job as a martial type.
I'd rather be taking a more intellectual and elegant nap—
m920203.だから、こちらも勝手にさせてもらう。\nせっかく育ててきた種を、\nこんなところ:
So, I'll do as I please.
I can't have you cutting down the seeds
I've cultivated with such care.
m920203.だから、守ってやる必要はない、と？\n人である内に殺してやるのが、\n慈悲ではな:
So, you think there is no need to protect them?
That killing them while they are still human
is not an act of mercy?
m920203.だから、安心して死出の道を進みなさい。: So, please proceed down the path to the afterlife with peace of mind.
m920203.だからこそ、亜神ディアスを討つのは、\n我ら神々自身の手によるものでなければ――:
That is why slaying the Demigod Dias must be done
by the hands of the gods themselves—
m920203.だからこそ、人の領分を超えぬうちに、\n王子、あなたには死んでもらうわ。\n神々:
That is why, before you surpass the limits of your mortal station,
Prince, I must have you die.
Forgive me in advance for taking your life for the gods' convenience.
m920203.だからその前に、人間のまま、\n生を終わらせてあげるのが、何よりの慈悲でしょ？:
So, before that happens, letting them end their life
as a human is the greatest mercy, isn't it?
m920203.だから前の時のことはあまり覚えてな――\nちっ……仕方ねぇか。:
That's why I don't remember much from the last time—
Tch… Fine, I guess.
m920203.だが、その先に待つのは、\n新たな神たるお前を巡る、神と人の境界なき戦争だ。\n:
But what awaits beyond that is
a war without borders between gods and humans,
centered on you, the new god.
It is a scale your hands cannot reach.
m920203.だが、それが分かれば対策のしようもある。\n王子、隕石にだって平気で耐えられるや:
But knowing that, we can prepare.
Prince, there must be one or two of your subordinates
who can shrug off a meteor strike, right?
m920203.だが、それゆえに、\n神々の駒として神の座に据えられる前に、\nお前を、人の身の:
But for that very reason,
before you are installed on the throne of the gods as their pawn,
I must kill you while you are still human.
m920203.だが、力の差は歴然だ。\n人が神に打ち勝つことは、できない。:
But the difference in power is stark.
Humans cannot defeat gods.
m920203.だが、私はそれを信じなかった。\n争い、嘆き、殺し合ってまで得られる成長が、\n:
But I did not believe in that.
Growth gained through strife, lamentation, and slaughter
could never outweigh the dignity of life!
m920203.ちっ……どいつもこいつも、人の言う事聞きやしねぇ。\n徐華、こいつは天墜神星の力:
Tch…… none of them listen to a word I say.
Xuhua, this is a fragment of Amatsumikaboshi's power.
The authority of a blazing star―― your stamina will drain in this heat wave!
m920203.ついこの前も一緒に共闘しただろう！\nはぁ……恨むぞ英雄王……！:
We just fought side by side not long ago!
Haa… I really resent you, Hero King…!
m920203.では、儀式を始める。\nそれからイコル、この戦いが終わった後には、\n再び助力を:
Then, let us begin the ritual.
And Ikol, I promise you here that I will offer my aid again
once this battle is over.
m920203.でも、あの人は身内にはやけに甘いけど、\n敵対した今、頼んでも助けてくれるとは―:
But, that person is unusually soft on their own side.
Now that we're enemies, I don't know if they'd help us even if we asked...
m920203.でも、なぜ神々が争ったのか――\nその伝承はきっと、残されていないでしょう？:
But why the gods fought in the first place――
that part of the legend is certainly lost to history, isn't it?
m920203.でも、天墜神星さまは、それを望まなかった。\n数多の血と死の上に成り立つ世界を否:
But Amatsumikaboshi did not want that.
He rejected a world built on countless blood and death,
and wished for a world where no one had to weep.
m920203.でも、姉さまは負けたりしない！\n姉さまは天才だから、天墜神星さまを降ろしても、:
But, my big sister won't lose!
My big sister is a genius, so even if she summons Amatsu-Mikaboshi-sama,
she absolutely won't die!!
m920203.どうせそんなことだろうと思ったさ。\n何しろ、タカマガハラの神々が争った時、\n:
I expected as much.
After all, when the gods of Takamagahara clashed,
you were the one who resisted until your very body was destroyed.
m920203.な、無くはないですけど！\nそれこそ次元の狭間から\n唯一無事に帰ってきたルキフ:
W-Well, it's not like there's nothing!
Like Lukifer, who was the only one to safely return
from the dimensional void!
m920203.なっ……神獣玉兎！？\nそんな、個人が神獣を召喚するなんて――:
Wha…… the Divine Beast, the Jade Rabbit?!
No way…… an individual summoning a Divine Beast――
m920203.なに、それなら経験者が先行しよう。\nほら共に行くぞアトナテス、\n裂け目に飛び:
Well, if that's the case, the experienced ones should go first.
Come on, Atnates. You've jumped through a rift before, haven't you?
m920203.ならば、一方的に殺すというのも過ちか。\n人が己の意志を諦めていないのなら、\n:
Then, killing you one-sidedly would be a mistake.
If a human has not abandoned their own will,
I cannot deny that.
m920203.ならば、諦めず抗い続けよ。\n我が星の力をもって、その全てを退けよう。:
Then, resist without giving up.
I will repel all of you with the power of my star.
m920203.のう、バスティスよ。\nおぬしの信者が見ておるぞ？:
Now then, Bastis.
Your devotees are watching, you know?
m920203.は、はいっ！\n姉さま、依代の座、あたしが引き継ぐよ！:
Y-Yes!
Big sister, I will take over the seat of the vessel!
m920203.はぁ……まぁ、そういうことなら。\n兵には嫌われたくないんですけどねぇ。:
Haa... Well, if that's how it is.
I just don't want to be disliked by the soldiers, you know.
m920203.はぁ……何か思いつくまで\nこうして持久戦するしかないってことかよ。:
Haa... So we're stuck in a war of attrition
until someone comes up with a plan, huh.
m920203.はぁ、訓練中を狙えば、\n王子を簡単に仕留められると思ったんだけどね。\nまさか:
??? : I thought if I struck while you were all busy training,
I could take out the Prince easily.
I didn't expect so many monsters to be gathered here.
m920203.はぁぁぁ……。\nもうどうにでもなれにゃ。\nさぁ次の模擬戦の相手は誰――:
Haaah…….
I don't care anymore.
So, who's up next for the sparring match—
m920203.はぁ？ ただの人間が、\nそんなに神の匂いを漂わせたりするものかよ。:
Huh? A mere human?
There's no way you'd carry that much divine aura.
m920203.はぁ？ って、おいおいおいおい！\nなんだあれ、流れ星か！？:
Huh? Wait, wait, wait, wait!
What is that? A meteor?!
m920203.ふむ……。\nだが、ケラウノスが築いた障壁は未だ機能している。\n「ただの人間」:
Hm…
But the barrier Keraunos constructed is still in effect.
You can't break through it with the power of an "ordinary human."
m920203.へぇ、小娘が何をするつもりだ？\n天墜神星の依代はそっちのヒミコだろう？\nただ:
Hmph, what does a little girl like you think you're doing?
The vessel for Amatsumikaboshi is Himiko over there, isn't it?
What can a mere shrine maiden like you possibly do?
m920203.へっ、それでこそ俺たちの旗印だ。\nさぁイヨ、てめぇの隠し玉を見せてみやがれ！:
Heh, that's the spirit!
Come on, Iyo. Show us your trump card!
m920203.まぁ、何考えてるのか分からない人ではあるけど……。\nって、あっ、あれ見て！\n:
Well, I can't really read what's going on in his head…
Wait, look at that!
The dimensional rift is still there!
m920203.まぁまぁ、嫌な伝統なら消えていたはずでしょう？\n走って殴って守る、戦場の基礎を:
Now, now, if it were a bad tradition, it would have died out by now, wouldn't it?
It's the perfect way to learn the basics of the battlefield—charging, striking, and defending—
while also deepening your bond with your comrades.
m920203.まったく。導くだの、正しさだの、\nそういうことを真顔で言えるのが、\n亜神の傲:
Honestly. Speaking of guidance and righteousness
with such a straight face is the very height of demi-god arrogance.
m920203.もし王子が神になったとして、\n彼が災禍を望むとでも？:
Even if the Prince were to become a god,
would he truly wish to bring about a calamity?
m920203.やけに、引き際が良すぎる気がしますね……。: It feels a little too convenient for him to leave so easily…
m920203.やめるにゃぁぁぁ！？ あたしのことを！\nきらきらした目で！ 見ないでにゃぁ～！:
Stop it?! Don't look at me
with those sparkly eyes!!
m920203.ゆえに、こいつは背中を任せられる相手だと、\n互いに認識するためには、\nこうす:
Therefore, to recognize each other as someone
whose back you could trust,
there was no other way but to do this.
m920203.わぁっ、伝説のコンビ復活ですね！\nヴィーディア♪ 仲良くしましょうねー♪:
Wow! The legendary duo is back!
Vidya♪ Let's get along, okay?♪
m920203.わわっと……なんじゃぁ？\n急に熱くなってきおったぞ？:
W-what…… what's this?
It's suddenly gotten really hot, hasn't it?
m920203.アマツミカボシ……？\nえぇ、神々に最後まで抗った悪神だと聞いているわ。:
Amatsumikaboshi……?
Yes, I've heard it was the evil god who resisted the gods until the very end.
m920203.アマツミカボシが隕石に施した術は、\n最も遅く戦場に駆けつけた者を優先して\n狙:
The spell Amatsu-Mikaboshi placed on the meteors
prioritizes targeting the one who arrives on the battlefield last.
m920203.イコル、か。\nすまないな、今は相手をしている時間がない。:
Ikol, is it?
I apologize, but I do not have time to deal with you right now.
m920203.イコル、亜神ディアスを討つという\nその一点においては、我々の目的は一致している:
Ikol, in the singular goal of slaying the demi-god Dias,
our purposes align.
m920203.イヨ、おかえりなさい。\n……無事に、全部片付いたわ。:
Iyo, welcome back.
…Everything is safely taken care of.
m920203.イヨ、もう十分よ。\n時間を稼いでくれたおかげで、こちらの準備ができたわ。:
Iyo, you've done more than enough.
Thanks to the time you bought us, our preparations are complete.
m920203.イルドナと協働して、世界中を駆け回る日々も終わりだ。\n今日からはまた、王国軍の:
Our days of working alongside Ildona and racing across the world are over.
From today, I'm asking you to return to your role as a force within the Royal Army.
m920203.イルドナの差金だ。\n現代の王国は製紙技術の発展が著しくてな。\n街ではお前の伝:
Ildona's doing.
The modern kingdom has seen remarkable progress in paper-making technology.
Your biography is a bestseller in the cities.
m920203.ザエモン、焚き付けてどうするんじゃ！\nおぬし面白がっておるじゃろ！:
Gorozaemon, what are you trying to do, stoking the flames like that!
You're just enjoying yourself, aren't you!
m920203.タカマガハラの神々は、\n人が正しく成長を続ける世界を夢みて\nこの大地を神から:
The gods of Takamagahara
dreamed of a world where humanity would continue to grow rightly,
and so they yielded this land from the divine to the human.
m920203.バスティス様と手合わせできるとは、何という栄誉！\nきょ、今日のことは、日記に残:
To be able to spar with Lady Bastis is such an honor!
I-I must record today's events in my diary and keep it as a family treasure…
m920203.ヒミコ、イヨも魔力を消耗しているはずだ。\n後のことは任せたぞ。:
Himiko and Iyo must be running low on mana as well.
I leave what comes next to you.
m920203.ヒミコよ、身体を返そう。\nお前は王子と共にオリュンポスへ至り、\nかの者の有り:
Himiko, I will return your body to you.
Go to Olympus with the Prince,
and judge the state of that being.
m920203.一度次元に亀裂を生じさせたあなたなら、\n何とかできたりしませんか？:
Since you've managed to tear a rift in the dimension before,
perhaps you could figure something out?
m920203.一騎打ちが戦の華になる前の時代、ね。\nそれじゃあ、隠れて隕石を降らせるのも、\:
An era before single combat was considered the pinnacle of warfare, huh.
I suppose we can't really call it cowardly
if he's hiding and raining meteors down on us...
m920203.不敬な、と言いたいところだけど、\nあいつの名代だというのなら仕方ない。\nだが:
I'd like to call that disrespectful,
but since you claim to act on his behalf, I suppose I have no choice.
But may I ask you something?
m920203.不穏分子を処分するには、\nうってつけの状況だろう。: It would be the perfect opportunity to dispose of the troublemakers.
m920203.亜神なのに戦うことを拒むなんて、\n第四層「ヌン」は変わった文化をお持ちなのです:
It's unusual for a Sub-deity to refuse combat.
The culture of the Fourth Layer, "Nun," is quite different, isn't it?
m920203.亜神の思惑によって、神の道を歩まされそうになっている、\n哀れな人間が物質界にい:
There is a pitiful human in the Material World
who is being forced to walk the path of the gods
due to the schemes of a Sub-deity.
m920203.亜神ディアスとの戦いも本格化していくだろう？\n本人は嫌がっていたが、実用的な戦:
The war against the Demigod Dias is about to intensify, isn't it?
She didn't want to, but it would be a waste
to leave such a practical fighting force idle.
m920203.交流を深めてもらうつもりで、\nこうして合同演習を企画してみたのですが……。\n:
I planned this joint exercise
with the intention of fostering better relations…
Could it have been a failure?
m920203.人が何かを作るように、\n創造神も人を作っただけに過ぎない。:
Just as humans create things,
the Creator God merely created humans.
m920203.人が神の助けなしに、\n千年の平穏を、自らの手で勝ち取るというのか。:
You mean for humans to win a thousand years of peace
with their own hands, without the gods' help?
m920203.人は誰かの意志で生まれるが――: A person is born by the will of another—
m920203.人間というのは、もっと愚かで、無謀で、\nいい加減で自分勝手で、\nそして、私た:
Humans are far more foolish, reckless,
careless, and selfish.
And, like us, they are beings with their own will.
m920203.他の神とて同じだ。\nただ生み出しただけ、神と人の差とはそれだけなのだ。:
The other gods are the same.
They simply brought things into existence. That is the only difference between gods and humans.
m920203.他人のことを言える立場か？\n守りたいもの、取り戻したいものを、\n傷つけてばか:
You have no right to lecture me.
You are a fool who only hurts the things
you claim to protect and reclaim.
